name: Peppers Seminyak
short_description: A luxury villa resort in Seminyak with 1-to-5-bedroom private-pool villas, a 4.8/5 ALL Rating (435 reviews), and walking distance to Seminyak's boutiques and restaurants.
ai_summary: Peppers Seminyak is a luxury villa resort in the Petitenget area of Seminyak, offering one-to-five-bedroom villas each with a private pool and garden — suited to honeymooners through to groups and families. The property holds a strong 4.8/5 ALL Rating from 435 reviews. On-site facilities include a day spa and The Laneway Restaurant, overlooking a rock pool and serving Balinese and Italian dishes. It's within walking distance of Seminyak's boutique shopping and dining, with a white-sand beach nearby. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
